title: Board resolutions

voice.rule: The company and its certifying officer: "I, [●], the [●] of [●] (the Company), hereby certify …".

spelling.rule: British -ise: authorised, authorises, finalise (the pack's "authorized" and "finalize" are changed).

title.text: Certified True Copy Of The Resolution Passed By The Board Of Directors Of [●] On [●]

certification.text: I, [●], the [●] of [●] (the Company), hereby certify that the following resolution was passed by the Board of Directors during the meeting held on [●]: Quote … Unquote

further_resolved.text: Further Resolved That the Company hereby authorises [●] (with power to sub-delegate) to …

ratification.text: Further Resolved That the Company hereby ratifies all prior and future acts, deeds and things lawfully undertaken by [●] …

duration.text: Further Resolved That this resolution shall remain effective and in full force until it is revoked or amended by another resolution and such revocation or amendment is duly notified and acknowledged.

signature.text: For And On Behalf Of [●] / ___________ / Name: / Designation: / Date:

notes: "Resolved That" / "Further Resolved That" in Title Case (the base); the pack's "UNANIMOUSLY RESOLVED that" is the alternative when the board was unanimous.
